entries.zh: 左侧的抽屉里放着较小的画笔。

entries.en: The archive includes newspapers from several left-wing political groups.
entries.zh: 档案中有几个左翼政治团体的报纸。

entries.en: The festival's line-up includes a choir and two folk bands.
entries.zh: 音乐节的演出阵容包括一个合唱团和两支民谣乐队。

entries.en: A middle-aged couple asked us for directions to the theater.
entries.zh: 一对中年夫妇向我们询问去剧院的路。

entries.en: The band reunited for a one-off performance at the anniversary celebration.
entries.zh: 乐队为周年庆重新聚首，只演出一次。

entries.en: Her one-time rival became a close friend during the tour.
entries.zh: 她从前的对手在巡演期间成了好友。

entries.en: My PLE brings reading notes and practice quizzes together.
entries.zh: 我的个人学习环境整合了阅读笔记与练习测验。

entries.en: The annual report lists both pre-tax and net earnings.
entries.zh: 年报同时列出了税前收益和净收益。

entries.meaningZh: 当选而尚未就任的总统
entries.en: The president-elect thanked volunteers at the end of the campaign.
entries.zh: 竞选结束时，当选总统向志愿者们致谢。

entries.en: His cruel put-down embarrassed the youngest member of the group.
entries.zh: 他刻薄的贬损话让小组中最年轻的成员十分难堪。

entries.en: Their quarter-final lasted longer than anyone had expected.
entries.zh: 他们那场四分之一决赛比所有人预想的都久。

entries.en: Take the right-hand path just beyond the stone fountain.
entries.zh: 过了石喷泉就走右侧的小路。

entries.meaningZh: 标榜进步立场的（常含讽刺）
entries.en: His right-on speeches sounded rehearsed rather than genuinely concerned.
entries.zh: 他那些标榜进步立场的演说听起来像背好的，而非真正出于关心。

entries.en: She had a run-in with the caretaker over rehearsal hours.
entries.zh: 她因排练时间与管理员起了争执。

entries.en: The workshop stayed busy in the run-up to the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览前的筹备阶段，工坊一直很忙。

entries.en: The runner-up congratulated the winner with an enthusiastic handshake.
entries.zh: 亚军热情地握手，向冠军道贺。

entries.en: Finishing the difficult project gave her self-esteem a welcome boost.
entries.zh: 完成这个艰难的项目让她的自尊心得到了可喜的提升。

entries.en: A late goal secured their place in the semi-final.
entries.zh: 一记临近终场的进球确保了他们的半决赛席位。

entries.en: An unexpected side-effect of the schedule was a quieter library.
entries.zh: 这个时间安排带来的一个意外附带影响是图书馆更安静了。

entries.en: The workers staged a sit-down inside the factory.
entries.zh: 工人们在工厂内举行了静坐抗议。

entries.en: Students organized a peaceful sit-in outside the closed library.
entries.zh: 学生们在关闭的图书馆外组织了一场和平静坐抗议。

entries.en: Her team-mate stayed behind to help carry the equipment.
entries.zh: 她的队友留了下来，帮忙搬运器材。

entries.meaningZh: 换新时用于折价的旧物
entries.en: They accepted our old camera as a trade-in.
entries.zh: 他们接受我们的旧相机作为以旧换新的折价物。

entries.en: Their conversation petered out as the train entered the tunnel.
entries.zh: 火车进入隧道时，他们的谈话渐渐停了下来。

entries.en: The organizers treated experienced performers and newcomers equally.
entries.zh: 组织者平等对待有经验的表演者和新人。

entries.en: "Aye," the captain replied, "the harbor is close."
entries.zh: “是的，”船长回答，“港口就在附近。”

entries.en: The ref stopped play when a dog crossed the pitch.
entries.zh: 一只狗穿过球场时，裁判暂停了比赛。

entries.en: Someone had left the mike switched on backstage.
entries.zh: 有人把后台的麦克风开着就走了。

entries.en: The spare room looks alright after a fresh coat of paint.
entries.zh: 客房重新刷漆后看着还不错。

entries.en: The design changed after consultation with the residents.
entries.zh: 与居民协商后，设计作了调整。

entries.en: The museum displayed a mummy inside a carefully lit case.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一个精心布光的展柜中展出了一具木乃伊。

entries.en: The guide pointed to the church's massive Norman arches.
entries.zh: 导游指了指教堂巨大的诺曼式拱门。

entries.en: The server stores copies of all our workshop photographs.
entries.zh: 服务器保存着我们所有工作坊照片的副本。

entries.en: A walker paused beside the sign to examine her map.
entries.zh: 一位徒步者在指示牌旁停下来查看地图。

entries.en: The baker dusted the wooden counter with flour.
entries.zh: 面包师在木柜台上撒了一层面粉。

entries.en: The collector lent three rare postcards to the exhibition.
entries.zh: 这位收藏者借出了三张珍稀明信片供展览使用。

entries.meaningZh: 大学一年级学生（美式英语）
entries.en: As a freshman, she joined the campus radio station.
entries.zh: 大学一年级时，她加入了校园广播站。

entries.en: Chalk drawings covered the sidewalk outside the community center.
entries.zh: 社区中心外的人行道上画满了粉笔画。

entries.en: "Wow, that kite is bigger than our tent!" she exclaimed.
entries.zh: “哇，那个风筝比我们的帐篷还大！”她惊叹道。

entries.en: Her studies in theology included a course on medieval manuscripts.
entries.zh: 她的神学学习中包括一门中世纪手稿课程。

entries.en: Firstly, thank you for helping us finish the exhibition.
entries.zh: 首先，感谢你们帮助我们完成展览。

entries.en: The tunnel looked scary until we saw daylight ahead.
entries.zh: 在我们看见前方的日光之前，那条隧道一直显得很吓人。

entries.en: Each juror studied the photograph before the witness continued.
entries.zh: 每位陪审员都仔细看过照片后，证人才继续作证。

entries.en: The courtroom scene was filmed in a converted warehouse.
entries.zh: 法庭那场戏是在一间改造过的仓库里拍摄的。

entries.en: Each workstation has an adjustable lamp and a drawing board.
entries.zh: 每个工作位都有一盏可调节台灯和一块画板。

entries.en: We watched the eclipse from our neighbor's backyard.
entries.zh: 我们在邻居家的后院观看了日食。

entries.en: The dough doubled in size beneath the clean cloth.
entries.zh: 干净布巾盖着的面团膨胀到了原来的两倍。

entries.en: Their morning workout ended with a friendly relay race.
entries.zh: 他们的晨练以一场友谊接力赛结束。
